newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador approves telephone privatization law.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador approves telephone privatization law.

text.p: El Salvador's Legislative Assembly on Thursday approved a telecommunications law that will divide the state telephone monopoly into two competing privatized companies.
A separate law must be approved later for privatization to take place.
The law was approved by a 44-0 vote after 40 opposition legislators stormed out in protest, saying the ruling National Republic Alliance (ARENA) rushed the legislation through.
Privatization of the National Telecommunications Administration, known as ANTEL, also was opposed by labor unions who consider the state telephone company profitable.
